caption: The drawing depicts two separate images on a cream-colored paper. At the top center, there is a simple line drawing of a jar with a wide body and two small handles near the rim. On the front of the jar, there is a small, sketchy portrait of a cherub-like face with stylized wings extending to either side of the head. Above the jar, some small text and the number "1½" are written. Below this, occupying the majority of the composition, is a larger, monochromatic brown image framed by a rough square border. This lower image depicts a head and shoulders of a cherub or angel, featuring a round face, small closed mouth, two dots for eyes, and curly hair, with large, symmetrical wings fanning outwards from the sides of the neck. The figure has a cross or similar symbol in the center at the base of the neck. The large cherub's features and wings are rendered in black and dark brown lines, with the entire section filled in with a brown wash that differentiates it from the lighter background. The artist's signature "Fumagalli" appears in small print at the bottom left corner of the construct.
title: Jar
